THIS LIMITATION OF</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC483" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="483" style="position:relative">     LIABILITY SHALL NOT APPLY TO LIABILITY FOR DEATH OR PERSONAL INJURY</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC484" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="484" style="position:relative">     RESULTING FROM SUCH PARTY&#039;S NEGLIGENCE TO THE EXTENT APPLICABLE LAW</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC485" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="485" style="position:relative">     PROHIBITS SUCH LIMITATION. Such altered versions are further</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC659" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="659" style="position:relative">prohibited from misrepresentative use of the Zip-Bugs or Info-ZIP</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC660" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="660" style="position:relative">e-mail addresses or the Info-ZIP URL(s), such as to imply Info-ZIP</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC661" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="661" style="position:relative">will provide support for the altered versions.</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC662" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="662" style="position:relative">
</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC663" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="663" style="position:relative">Info-ZIP retains the right to use the names &quot;Info-ZIP,&quot; &quot;Zip,&quot;</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC664" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="664" style="position:relative">&quot;UnZip,&quot; &quot;UnZipSFX,&quot; &quot;WiZ,&quot; &quot;Pocket UnZip,&quot; &quot;Pocket Zip,&quot; and &quot;MacZip&quot;</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC665" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="665" style="position:relative">for its own source and binary releases.</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC666" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="666" style="position:relative">

More considerations for licensors:</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC738" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="738" style="position:relative">	wiki.creativecommons.org/Considerations_for_licensors</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC739" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="739" style="position:relative">
</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC740" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="740" style="position:relative">     Considerations for the public: By using one of our public</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC741" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="741" style="position:relative">     licenses, a licensor grants the public permission to use the</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC742" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="742" style="position:relative">     licensed material under specified terms and conditions. If</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC743" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="743" style="position:relative">     the licensor&#039;s permission is not necessary for any reason--for</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC744" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="744" style="position:relative">     example, because of any applicable exception or limitation to</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC745" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="745" style="position:relative">     copyright--then that use is not regulated by the license. Our</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC746" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="746" style="position:relative">     licenses grant only permissions under copyright and certain</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC747" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="747" style="position:relative">     other rights that a licensor has authority to grant. Use of</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC748" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="748" style="position:relative">     the licensed material may still be restricted for other</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC749" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="749" style="position:relative">     reasons, including because others have copyright or other</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC750" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="750" style="position:relative">     rights in the material. A licensor may make special requests,</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC751" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="751" style="position:relative">     such as asking that all changes be marked or described.</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC752" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="752" style="position:relative">     Although not required by our licenses, you are encouraged to</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC753" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="753" style="position:relative">     respect those requests where reasonable. More_considerations</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC754" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="754" style="position:relative">     for the public: </div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC755" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="755" style="position:relative">	wiki.creativecommons.org/Considerations_for_licensees</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC756" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="756" style="position:relative">

Adapted Material means material subject to Copyright and Similar</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC774" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="774" style="position:relative">     Rights that is derived from or based upon the Licensed Material</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC775" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="775" style="position:relative">     and in which the Licensed Material is translated, altered,</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC776" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="776" style="position:relative">     arranged, transformed, or otherwise modified in a manner requiring</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC777" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="777" style="position:relative">     permission under the Copyright and Similar Rights held by the</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC778" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="778" style="position:relative">     Licensor. Sui Generis Database Rights means rights other than copyright</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC826" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="826" style="position:relative">     resulting from Directive 96/9/EC of the European Parliament and of</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC827" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="827" style="position:relative">     the Council of 11 March 1996 on the legal protection of databases,</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC828" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="828" style="position:relative">     as amended and/or succeeded, as well as other essentially</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC829" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="829" style="position:relative">     equivalent rights anywhere in the world.</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC830" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="830" style="position:relative">
</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC831" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="831" style="position:relative">  k. You means the individual or entity exercising the Licensed Rights</div></div></div><div class="react-code-text react-code-line-contents" style="min-height:auto"><div><div id="LC832" class="react-file-line html-div" data-testid="code-cell" data-line-number="832" style="position:relative">     under this Public License.
